strings.help.text:
HideyNotes — quick notes at the edge of the screen.

PANEL
• Ctrl+Shift+Space — show or hide the panel.
• Clicking the tab at the right edge does the same.
• Esc closes the search and the settings first, then hides the panel.
• Ctrl+P opens or closes the settings — the same as the gear.
• The panel hides itself when it loses focus; the delay is adjustable in the settings.
• The pin in the header stops that hiding until the app restarts: the panel stays open while you work in other windows. The hotkey, Esc and the × still hide it.
• The tab and the panel can live at the right or the left edge; the Screen edge setting switches them.
• To close the app completely use the tray icon or Ctrl+Q.
• The settings can pin the panel to a specific monitor (by default — the one with the cursor).

TABS
• Ctrl+T — new note.
• Ctrl+W — close the tab (the note goes to history).
• Ctrl+Shift+W — close and forget, no history.
• Ctrl+Shift+T — reopen the last closed one.
• Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab — next and previous tab.
• Ctrl+1…9 or Alt+1…9 — jump to a tab by number.
• F2 or a double click on a tab — rename.
• Tabs can be dragged with the mouse, a middle click closes one.

SEARCH
• Ctrl+F — open or close the search over the current note (the query is remembered).
• Ctrl+Shift+F — the same but over every tab; with the search already open the other shortcut only switches the scope.
• Enter or F3 — next match, Shift+F3 — previous one.
• "Note" searches the current note, "All" searches every note; tabs without matches are hidden.

SAVING
• Ctrl+S or the button in the header — save the note as .txt.
• Drafts are saved automatically, so nothing is lost when the app closes.

HISTORY AND TRASH
• Ctrl+H — open or close the window.
• Ctrl+F in the history window — search titles and text (both closed notes and the trash).
• "Closed" — tabs you closed. Restore them or move them to the trash.
• "Trash" — notes deleted from the closed list. Put them back or delete them forever.
• Notes live 30 days in both lists, then they are removed for good.
• The "Help" tab never goes to history: closed means gone.

SETTINGS
• The gear in the header (or Ctrl+P): text (font, size, spacing, padding, color) and behavior (hiding, theme, language, monitor, hotkey, search memory).
• F1 — open this help page.
